title: AU-EU Youth Action Lab Grants 2026
caption:
💰 AU-EU Youth Action Lab Grants 2026

Non-dilutive grants of 30,000 to 50,000 euros for youth-led organizations in Nigeria and eleven other African countries running mission-driven projects.

📅 Deadline: 23 September 2026
✅ Eligibility: Youth-led organizations (led by people aged 18 to 35) registered in Nigeria or one of 11 other focus countries

No fees. No gatekeeping. Full details + how to apply (link in bio):
https://keenafrica.com/blog/2026-08-28-au-eu-youth-action-lab-grants-2026.html
